summary_1line: Durvasa and thousands of disciples visit the exiled Pandavas; Draupadi prays to Krishna, whose miracle fills the sages so they flee before eating.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi, anxious and prayerful in the forest hut, raises her hands while invoking Krishna for help.
Krishna examines the empty vessel and eats a single grain of rice stuck to its rim.
Durvasa and his thousands of disciples, suddenly feeling full after bathing in the river, look at each other in alarm before fleeing into the forest.
